title: A recovery drill primes a fresh Postgres from the pg_dump artefact and the row-count and checksum match the source
asA: operator running a recovery drill on a schedule to prove the pg_dump path works
iWant: the drill to prime a fresh Postgres from the artefact and compare the restored dataset against the source by row-count and checksum
soThat: the recovery path is proven end to end and drift on the artefact shape is caught before an incident forces a live restore

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a live Postgres with a fixture rowset and a pg_dump artefact produced by the scheduled runner, when the drill primes a fresh Postgres from the artefact and computes the row-count and checksum of the fixture table on both databases, then the row-count and checksum on the restored Postgres equal those on the source and a recoveryDrillPassed event fires on the event sink carrying the two matched values.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a source Postgres seeded with a fixture rowset and a pg_dump artefact at the elicited destination
acceptanceCriteria.when: the drill primes a fresh Postgres from the artefact and runs SELECT count(*) and a checksum aggregate on the fixture table against both databases
acceptanceCriteria.then: the two counts are equal; the two checksums are equal; recoveryDrillPassed fires on the event sink with { count, checksum }; the fresh Postgres and its artefact primer are torn down on exit

acceptanceCriteria.description: Recovery drill upstream failure. Given the pg_dump artefact is corrupt (or the target restore database is not empty), when the recovery-drill verb runs, then the drill refuses with a named error kind (recoveryDrillFailed) carrying the psql restore exit code and a sample of the first failing statement; recoveryDrillCompleted does not fire; the corrupt input is not silently accepted.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a corrupt pg_dump artefact or a non-empty restore target
acceptanceCriteria.then: the drill refuses with recoveryDrillFailed carrying psql exit code and first failing statement sample; recoveryDrillCompleted does not fire
